text:
Maya (Growth): Quick sync 1: speaker promo assets + lead routing. Want to finalize today so demand gen can schedule emails.

Liz (Speaker Ops): Two promo clips requested per speaker: 1) 30s technical hook, 2) 15s social CTA. Keep vertical-safe (no internal metrics). Need raw video by Wed EOD.

Alex (Benchmarks): I'll record a 30s clip: highlight 'live cost calculator' and one stat: typical perf delta between quant profiles. Will keep a 15s cut too.

Samir (Product): For CTA, prefer: 'Join to download the cost workbook + hands-on breakouts'. avoid 'free trial' phrasing to reduce sales friction.

Rhea (Demand Gen): Email flow plan: 3-touch cadence. Invite, reminder (24h), last-chance (1h). Segment: trial users, enterprise leads, partners. Different subject line tests for each.

Maya (Growth): lead routing: canonical mapping -> Marketo list "Webinar_Inference_May14"; SFDC Campaign: "Webinar_Inference_May14"; webhook to collect fast opt-ins for AE routing. Need webhook schema.

Samir (Product): suggested webhook payload: 

```
POST /events/webinar-inference
{
  "email": "...",
  "company": "...",
  "utm_source": "...",
  "interest_level": "workbook|demo|partner",
  "timestamp": "..."
}
```

Samir (Product): set interest_level values so AEs get priority routing (demo -> hot queue).

Rhea (Demand Gen): also request an 'speaker_interest' flag if registrant checks 'follow up with speaker'. That maps to speaker ops list for follow-ups.

Liz (Speaker Ops): we'll need a simple template for follow-ups. keep it short: thank you + ask if they'd like an intro to speaker + calendar link.

Alex (Benchmarks): for the post-event CTA I propose 2 downloads: cost workbook (immediate) and a benchmark snapshot (gated). Send workbook to everyone, snapshot only to those who opted for 'benchmark download'.

Maya (Growth): good. Also: can we auto-tag registrants by breakout choice? want to feed that into nurture flows.

Samir (Product): poll on the landing form or live poll at T+2min. If landing form, use hidden field 'breakout_choice'. If live poll, must capture email -> trickier. Recommend landing form choice.

Rhea (Demand Gen): landing form will have shortlist + checkbox for speaker follow-up. We'll map to Marketo fields: breakout_preference, speaker_follow_up.

GreenroomBot: rehearsal scheduled May 12 10:00 PT (dry run). Greenroom May 14 09:30 PT (join link in calendar). Auto-reminder T-30m.

Liz (Speaker Ops): promo checklist for speakers: 1) record two clips, 2) provide 2-liner bio, 3) nominate a backup contact for day-of. Deadline Wed EOD.

Maya (Growth): copy tests: 
- Subject A: "See how teams cut inference costs by 3x  live"
- Subject B: "Live: cost lab + hands-on inference breakouts"
Rhea: we'll run A/B across 30/70 split and measure CTR->register.

Alex (Benchmarks): one more ask: include one reproducible snippet in the slide deck for attendees to run in Colab. must be <10 lines and use public weights or dummy model.

Samir (Product): final run-of-show draft: 
00:00 - 00:05 Intro + poll (live)
00:05 - 00:25 Live cost lab demo (Alex)
00:25 - 00:45 Breakouts (3 rooms)
00:45 - 00:55 Panel + Q&A
00:55 - 01:00 Wrap + CTAs

Maya (Growth): action items: speakers deliver clips + bio by Wed EOD; Alex deliver Colab snippet + slide snapshot by Fri EOD; Rhea to map Marketo fields and create email cadence by Mon. Samir to share webhook schema to Eng.

Liz (Speaker Ops): noted. I'll send the speaker brief and calendar invites today. ping me if anyone needs recording tips. :video_camera:

Maya (Growth): thanks all. locking these items unless objections by EOD.
